title: Answer: free will is a quale of chaotic systems that model themselves as agents yet cannot predict themselves

statements.text: Free will is a quale, a felt quality of experience, and not a power of qualia over physics. Principia Qualia argues that the brain is a chaotic, critical dynamic system with an internal model of itself as an agent that still cannot predict itself, and that any conscious system with such dynamics will have the quale of free will and the illusion that its qualia have causal power. Conscious systems without this quale are possible, though it is plausibly common among evolved organisms, since unpredictable behavior tends to be adaptive.
statements.scope: Principia Qualia (2016), its appendix on the reality mapping problem
